elements.description: A docs page's Copy page button: copy it as Markdown for a model, view it, copy its link, open it in an assistant, download it.

properties.name: markdown
properties.description: The page as Markdown; when it's empty, `getMarkdown` is asked

properties.name: getMarkdown
properties.description: Makes the page's Markdown on demand (fetched or rendered when first needed); its answer is kept

properties.name: url
properties.description: The page's address, for Copy link and the assistants' prompt; without it those items aren't offered

properties.name: pageTitle
properties.description: The page's title, for the download's file name and the dialog

properties.name: filename
properties.description: The download's file name; defaults to the title in dashes, then .md

properties.name: assistants
properties.description: Chat assistants to open the page in, in order

properties.name: open
properties.description: The menu is open. Changed by the arrow button unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-page-copy
events.description: The page's Markdown or link is about to be copied ({ kind, text }: CopyPageCopy); cancelable – prevented, nothing is written to the clipboard

events.name: tc-page-view
events.description: View as Markdown was chosen ({ markdown }: CopyPageView); cancelable – prevented, the dialog doesn't open

events.name: tc-assistant-open
events.description: An assistant's link was chosen ({ id, href, prompt }: CopyPageAssistantOpen); cancelable – prevented, the link isn't followed

events.name: tc-page-download
events.description: Download .md was chosen ({ filename, markdown }: CopyPageDownload); cancelable – prevented, nothing is saved

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The menu opened or closed ({ open }: CopyPageOpenChange); cancelable – prevented, `open` stays

methods.name: copyMarkdown
methods.description: Copy the page as Markdown – the main button, or the first menu item

functions.name: assistantHref
functions.signature: assistantHref(template: string, prompt: string): string | null
functions.description: The assistant's link: its template with the prompt URL-encoded in place of "{prompt}"; null when it isn't a safe http(s) link

functions.name: markdownFilename
functions.description: A file name for the page: the title in lower-case words joined by dashes, then .md

props.name: open
props.description: The menu is open – controlled when given

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open at first, when `open` isn't controlled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes

props.name: onPageCopy
props.description: The Markdown or the link is about to be copied; return false to copy it your own way

props.name: onPageView
props.description: View as Markdown was chosen; return false to show it your own way

props.name: onAssistantOpen
props.description: An assistant's link was chosen; return false to open it your own way

props.name: onPageDownload
props.description: Download .md was chosen; return false to save it your own way

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: <dialog> and showModal()
features.why: Modals trap focus, close on Escape and sit in the top layer.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
